title: Complete arch digital implant capture using a smartphone-based photogrammetry app: An in vitro comparative study of the accuracy of different fiducial marker designs
html: A smartphone-based photogrammetry app has recently been introduced as an accurate and cost-effective alternative to conventional extraoral photogrammetry and intraoral photogrammetry devices for complete arch implant capture. However, the influence of the fiducial marker design on its trueness and precision has not been investigated.
